name: Ongole

queries.query: Ongole Andhra Pradesh official land records cadastral parcel map API MeeBhoomi
queries.result: First-party discovery found Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha, the state cadastral mapping viewer, and the APSAC official GIS Cadastral Maps application. The public configuration identifies an Andhra Pradesh cadastral map service, but no safe anonymous feature response with parcel identity and geometry was obtained.

queries.query: ఒంగోలు ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ అధికారిక భూ రికార్డులు కాడస్ట్రల్ పార్సెల్ మ్యాప్
queries.result: Telugu-language first-party discovery located the Andhra Pradesh Bhuseva land-information portal and Telugu references to official land-record services. The APSAC/Bhunaksha first-party cadastral viewer was also identified, but no bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

researchNote: Andhra Pradesh first-party cadastral mapping is evidenced through Bhunaksha and APSAC. The exposed ArcGIS layer is a map-only service; its public layer metadata identifies polygon geometry, CRS 4326 source data / 3857 service view, and native fields including objectid, dmvcd, district/mandal/village names and parcelnam. No parcel feature response was qualified. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
